items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: And Bob McDonald, who’s since passed away, led that band and he would bring in ringers from town you know to help us out

ctx.x: Actually it was the first lab band really I would say. Except you couldn’t get a degree in that kind of music at the school. But it was the first band that played student arrangements and they had a recording studio, like a radio studio, it was called a radio and recording orchestra, or band. And Bob McDonald, who’s since passed away, led that band and he would bring in ringers from town you know to help us out and to show us how they should be played. And he also had charts by some out of Stan’s book and Woody’s…
